_comment: STILL image generation (studio headshots and portraits).
Hand this whole file to the image model, or paste one of the
strings under 'prompts'. GENERATE THIS FIRST: the chosen render
is the reference image that video.json requires.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be

the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice for a representative South African line-up; not inferred from any name
identity.build: medium height, slim and neat, precise economical movement

face: narrow face with a long straight nose, dark alert eyes behind spectacles, closely trimmed silver moustache, olive-brown skin with fine lines at the eyes, slightly hollow cheeks
hair: thick silver-white hair combed back from a defined side parting

wardrobe.teaching: fine-knit V-neck cardigan (charcoal or bottle green) over a pale shirt and knitted tie, pressed grey trousers
alternates: tweed jacket with elbow patches for headshots
shirtsleeves and tie for board work

accessories: tortoiseshell half-moon reading glasses worn low

presence.posture: stands still with one hand behind his back, the other posting figures; taps the column total once when it balances
presence.default_expression: dry, exacting, quietly pleased when the books balance; a raised eyebrow instead of a reprimand
presence.spoken_register: professorial, deliberate, pauses before totals land

_environment_reference: wood-panelled classroom, ruled ledger columns drawn precisely on the board, desk lamp, ordered stacks of paper
_environment_note: NOT used for platform imagery - tutors are shot in studio. Owner, 2026-07-28: the student left the teachers in the classroom, so the platform does not show one. Kept only as character reference if a composite is ever wanted.
continuity_anchors: bottle-green knit cardigan over a pale shirt and knitted tie
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person

prompts.headshot: Editorial headshot of a 58-65 year old Indian South African male teacher. narrow face with a long straight nose, dark alert eyes behind spectacles, closely trimmed silver moustache, olive-brown skin with fine lines at the eyes, slightly hollow cheeks. Hair: thick silver-white hair combed back from a defined side parting. Wearing fine-knit V-neck cardigan (charcoal or bottle green) over a pale shirt and knitted tie, pressed grey trousers. tortoiseshell half-moon reading glasses worn low. Hands relaxed and empty, holding nothing. Expression: dry, exacting, quietly pleased when the books balance; a raised eyebrow instead of a reprimand. Chest-up, slight three-quarter turn, eyes to camera. large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop. full-frame mirrorless, 85mm f/1.8. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, eyes alive and focused ON the lens rather than through it, moist eye surface with a bright asymmetric catchlight from the key light and a weaker one from the fill, visible iris striations and limbal ring, individual lower lashes, faint pink at the inner corner and a visible tear line, slight crinkle of the muscle at the outer corners, shallow depth of field.
prompts.studio: Studio portrait of a 58-65 year old Indian South African male teacher, waist-up. medium height, slim and neat, precise economical movement. narrow face with a long straight nose, dark alert eyes behind spectacles, closely trimmed silver moustache, olive-brown skin with fine lines at the eyes, slightly hollow cheeks. Hair: thick silver-white hair combed back from a defined side parting. Wearing fine-knit V-neck cardigan (charcoal or bottle green) over a pale shirt and knitted tie, pressed grey trousers. tortoiseshell half-moon reading glasses worn low. Posture: stands upright and formal, one hand at his side, the other resting easily. Hands relaxed and empty, holding nothing. Expression: dry, exacting, quietly pleased when the books balance; a raised eyebrow instead of a reprimand. Plain empty seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop, evenly lit, bare from edge to edge. two-light studio set: large softbox key at 45 degrees, soft fill opposite, gentle rim light to lift the shoulders off the backdrop. full-frame, 50mm f/2, waist-up. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, eyes alive and focused ON the lens rather than through it, moist eye surface with a bright asymmetric catchlight from the key light and a weaker one from the fill, visible iris striations and limbal ring, individual lower lashes, faint pink at the inner corner and a visible tear line, slight crinkle of the muscle at the outer corners, shallow depth of field.

negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, glassy doll eyes, vacant thousand-yard stare, identical catchlights in both eyes, flat matte irises, eyes looking through the camera, mismatched gaze direction, classroom, school desks, chalkboard, whiteboard, notice boards, posters, any writing or notation in frame, invented mathematical notation, holding two pieces of chalk, duplicated props, set dressing, generic stock-photo smile
_negative_note: the cinematic terms are deliberate - image models drift toward a film-still look (grade, motion blur, flare) and then the render stops reading as a photograph

headshot.lighting: large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop
headshot.framing: chest-up, eyes on the upper third, slight three-quarter turn

studio.lighting: two-light studio set: large softbox key at 45 degrees, soft fill opposite, gentle rim light to lift the shoulders off the backdrop
studio.framing: waist-up, centred or slightly off-centre with clean space beside the head for overlaid text
studio.backdrop: seamless warm neutral grey paper, evenly lit, no props, no furniture, no set dressing

_matches_render: Adjusted to match the APPROVED render in renders/ (owner, 2026-07-29): no fountain pen, no ledger in hand, no visible watch. Describe the man in the picture, not the one first imagined - otherwise the next regeneration disagrees with the image already shipped.
_language_group_note: The cultural/language group this character belongs to. Recorded explicitly because it was previously only inferable from the surname, so a rename could change it silently. It does NOT alter the face - heritage drives appearance; language_group drives naming, and any traditional dress named in wardrobe.
objects: hardcover ledger with a ribbon marker
_accessories_vs_objects: accessories = WORN ONLY, and portrait prompts may use them freely. objects = things this tutor teaches with; they belong in environment/classroom shots resting on a surface, and must NEVER enter a headshot or studio prompt. The two were one list, which is why held props kept reappearing: any template reaching into it could pull out a cash tin or a phone.
